title: Bible Graph — reading path source file
description: A curated, ordered sequence of nodes through the graph. Paths are the source of truth; each node's suggested_reading_paths field in dist/ is derived from these files at build time.

audience.description: Who this path is for, in one sentence.

coverage.description: 'full' = the path walks every node of its declared canon layers (coverage is enforced). 'slice' = deliberately partial (a doorway or themed selection); coverage is not enforced, but steps resting on hard prerequisites the path never covers are reported.

order.description: 'enforced' = every hard prerequisite must appear earlier in the sequence (build fails otherwise). 'advisory' = the path deliberately orders by something other than the prerequisite graph; breaks are reported, never fatal. Use sparingly and say why in the description.

canon_layers.description: Layers this path draws from. Core-only paths must reference only core nodes (enforced by validate.mjs).

movements.description: Optional. Named chapters of a long journey path, in order. Each movement covers a contiguous block of the sequence, so the app can show journey-scale progress without exposing graph structure. Sum of node_count must equal the sequence length, and each start_node must match the first node of its block (enforced by validate.mjs). Absent on short linear paths.

start_node.description: Node id of the first sequence step in this movement; integrity anchor.

note.description: Optional: why this node sits here in the sequence.
